# Clear Choice Payment Solutions

> Clear Choice Payment Solutions is a Switch Commerce company that helps businesses build stable, revenue-focused payment systems.

Clear Choice Payment Solutions serves merchants, ATM operators, retail locations, travel venues, and payment partners with merchant services, ATM placement, Watchdog monitoring, all-in-one kiosks, foreign exchange ATMs, and affiliate program options.
